# Anthropic / Claude Platform release notes — captured 2026-08-27
# Source used: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/api
# (sources.json still points at platform.claude.com/docs/api/getting-started and
#  /docs/build-with-claude/overview — BOTH still HTTP 404. Recommended for months, still unfixed.)

## ADVANCED. Newest dated entry is now AUGUST 26, 2026 (was August 20 on the 08-26 scan).

### August 26, 2026 — THREE items, all new

1. Compliance API session endpoints are OUT OF BETA for Cowork and Claude Code sessions.

2. *** Compliance API local session endpoints now ALSO return transcripts of: ***
     - Claude Science sessions            product_surface = `claude_science`
     - Claude for Microsoft 365 sessions  product_surface = `office_agents/excel`,
                                          `office_agents/powerpoint`, `office_agents/word`,
                                          `office_agents/outlook`
                                          (`office_agents` alone when the app is unidentified)
   In BETA for Claude Enterprise orgs. NO new key, scope, setting or client update:
   existing Compliance Access Key + `read:compliance_user_data` scope.

3. Admin API is now available in the `ant` CLI (`ant beta:organization`) and in the
   Python, TypeScript, C#, Go, Java, PHP and Ruby SDKs under `client.beta.organization`.
   Covers: organization info, members, invites, workspaces + workspace members, API keys,
   rate limits, service accounts, WORKLOAD IDENTITY FEDERATION issuers and rules, and
   CUSTOMER-MANAGED ENCRYPTION KEYS.
   Usage/cost reports and the Claude Enterprise user-management + analytics endpoints
   remain curl-only. Reads an Admin API key from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or an `org:admin`
   OAuth token from ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN. Automated workloads skip login entirely and
   authenticate through WIF — the SDKs/CLI perform the token exchange from the federation
   environment variables.

## COMPLIANCE API SESSION SURFACE — full map (compliance-sessions page)

Two endpoint families, both READ-ONLY, both 403 for Admin API keys (`sk-ant-admin01-...`):

  LOCAL   /v1/compliance/apps/sessions/local           id prefix `clls_`
          /v1/compliance/apps/sessions/local/{id}
          /v1/compliance/apps/sessions/local/{id}/messages
          product_surface: cowork, claude_code, claude_science, office_agents/*

  REMOTE  /v1/compliance/apps/sessions/remote          id prefix `cse_`
          /v1/compliance/apps/sessions/remote/{id}/messages
          product_surface: cowork_remote ONLY

Local capture is SERVER-SIDE: "Anthropic records each conversation server-side as its
requests reach the Claude API; nothing is installed on the device." => transcripts show
what Claude was ASKED and what it RETURNED, not what happened on the device. Activity
that never reaches the API is invisible.

### DOCUMENTED BLIND SPOTS (these double as a coverage map)
NOT returned by the session endpoints:
 - Claude Code authenticated with a Console API key, or run via Bedrock / Vertex / Foundry.
 - Claude Code on the WEB (runs in Anthropic cloud but is NOT a remote session; remote
   endpoints return Cowork only).
 - Local sessions in orgs with HIPAA readiness enabled (no local data captured AT ALL).
 - Local sessions under zero data retention (excluded from lists; 404 on retrieve).
Never in a transcript:
 - Thinking blocks. System prompt (replaced by `[system prompt content not shown]` marker).
 - TOOL DEFINITIONS and MCP SERVER CONFIGURATION.
 - Images/PDFs/binary blocks; non-text tool-result items (web search results, code-exec
   output) collapse to `[N non-text item(s) not shown]` — the matching tool_use with the
   query/code in `input` IS still returned.
 - Citation metadata.
Tool inputs and each tool-result text entry are truncated to 10,000 bytes by default
(`tool_use_input_max_bytes` / `tool_result_max_bytes`; pass -1 for ~1 MiB max). A truncated
tool_use `input` is NO LONGER VALID JSON.
CLAUDE.md appears as ordinary user content. Skill content appears when the client sends it
as message content and is NOT distinguished from other user text.
Retention: 6 years default, or the org's custom conversation retention period (shortest
wins when several are configured). `created_at` ADVANCES as calls age out — deduplicate on `id`.
`provenance` types: content_unavailable (reasons: not_captured / client_aborted /
cmek_key_revoked / retention_elapsed / oversize), client_asserted, synthetic_marker.
NOTE: `not_captured` "does not prove that no record was stored" — content withheld by
Anthropic's data-handling policies reports the same reason.
Remote sessions can be AGENT-OWNED: `agent_id` prefix `cagt_`, with `started_by_user`
naming the human who initiated (e.g. a scheduled task). user_ids[] filter EXCLUDES
agent-owned sessions.
Claude Science emits SEPARATE background sessions for its own work — conversation naming,
and on newer versions its REVIEWER and DELEGATION TRACKS. => Claude Science has sub-agents.
Claude for M365: deleting a conversation in the add-in is CLIENT-ONLY and is not reflected
in the API; local sessions have no `deleted_at`.

### August 20, 2026 and earlier — unchanged, carried forward
Python SDK v1.0 (httpx -> httpx2); computer_toolset_20260801 + browser_toolset_20260801 on
Google Cloud; computer use out of beta; browser use tool launched; Files API out of beta.
